arxiv-2102-12586.title: A Stochastic Optimization Framework for Fair Risk Minimization
arxiv-2102-12586.creator: Andrew Lowy lowya@usc.edu, Sina Baharlouei baharlou@usc.edu, Rakesh Pavan rpavan@uw.edu, Meisam Razaviyayn razaviya@usc.edu, Ahmad Beirami beirami@google.com
arxiv-2102-12586.description: Abstract Despite the success of large-scale empirical risk minimization (ERM) at achieving high accuracy across a variety of machine learning tasks, fair ERM is hindered by the incompatibility of fairness constraints with stochastic optimization. We consider the problem of fair classification with discrete sensitive attributes and potentially large models and data sets, requiring stochastic solvers.

arxiv-2205-06424.title: On multilevel Monte Carlo methods for deterministic and uncertain hyperbolic systems Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2205-06424.creator: Junpeng Hu, Shi Jin, Jinglai Li, Lei Zhang
arxiv-2205-06424.description: Abstract In this paper, we evaluate the performance of the multilevel Monte Carlo method (MLMC) for deterministic and uncertain hyperbolic systems, where randomness is introduced either in the modeling parameters or in the approximation algorithms. MLMC is a well known variance reduction method widely used to accelerate Monte Carlo (MC) sampling.

arxiv-2311-05148.title: Orthogonal projections in the plane over prime order fields
arxiv-2311-05148.creator: Ben Lund, Thang Pham, Le Anh Vinh
arxiv-2311-05148.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ben Lund, Thang Pham, Le Anh Vinh. We give an upper bound on the number of exceptional orthogonal projections of a small set of points in a plane over a prime order field, which makes progress toward a conjecture of Chen (2018). This theorem relies on a new upper bound on the number of incidences between an arbitrary set of lines and a set of points contained in a reasonably small pencil of lines.

arxiv-2504-18366.title: Amending CALPHAD databases using a neural network for predicting mixing enthalpy of liquids Journal: Computational Materials Science
arxiv-2504-18366.creator: Clement Vincely, Amin Reiners-Sakic, Vedant Dave, Erwin Povoden-Karadeniz, Elmar Rueckert, Ronald Schnitzer, David Holec
arxiv-2504-18366.description: Abstract In order to establish the thermodynamic stability of a system, knowledge of its Gibbs free energy is essential. Most often, the Gibbs free energy is predicted within the CALPHAD framework using models employing thermodynamic properties, such as the mixing enthalpy, heat capacity, and activity coefficients.

arxiv-2504-19754.title: Reconstructing Context
arxiv-2504-19754.creator: Carlo Merola, Jaspinder Singh
arxiv-2504-19754.description: Abstract Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a transformative approach for enhancing large language models (LLMs) by grounding their outputs in external knowledge sources. Yet, a critical question persists: how can vast volumes of external knowledge be managed effectively within the input constraints of LLMs? Traditional methods address this by chunking external documents into smaller, fixed-size segments.

arxiv-2508-02916.title: Quantum Bootstrap Approach to a Non-Relativistic Potential for Quarkonium systems
arxiv-2508-02916.creator: Jairo Alexis Lopez, Carlos Sandoval
arxiv-2508-02916.description: Abstract The quantum bootstrap method is applied to determine the bound-state spectrum of Quarkonium systems using a non-relativistic potential approximation. The method translates the Schrödinger equation into a set of algebraic recursion relations for radial moments ⟨ r m ⟩ \langle r^{m}\rangle , which are constrained by the positive semidefiniteness of their corresponding Hankel matrices.

arxiv-2602-14165.title: Bidirectional Quantum Processor Interfacing by a 4-Kelvin Analog Signal Chain for Superconducting Qubit Control and Quantum State Readout
arxiv-2602-14165.creator: Deepak R V 1 , Lokendra Kanawat 2 , Jayadeep K 2 , and Priyesh Shukla 2 1 IIT Tirupati, India, 2 IIIT Hyderabad, India
arxiv-2602-14165.description: Abstract This paper presents a comprehensive cryogenic analog signal processing architecture designed for superconducting qubit control and quantum state readout operating at 4 Kelvin. The proposed system implements a complete bidirectional signal path bridging room-temperature digital controllers with quantum processors at millikelvin stages.

pmc-10664490.title: EPR spin trapping of nucleophilic and radical reactions at colloidal metal chalcogenide quantum dot surfaces†
pmc-10664490.creator: Caroline J. Aschendorf, Mawuli Degbevi, Keaton V. Prather, Emily Y. Tsui
pmc-10664490.description: The participation of the surfaces of colloidal semiconductor nanocrystal quantum dots (QDs) in QD-mediated photocatalytic reactions is an important factor that distinguishes QDs from other photosensitizers (e.g. transition metal complexes or organic dyes). Here, we probe nucleophilic and radical reactivity of surface sulfides and selenides of metal chalcogenide (CdSe, CdS, ZnSe, and PbS) QDs using chemical reactions and NMR spectroscopy.

pmc-11403353.title: Physical therapy registries worldwide: A systematic review
pmc-11403353.creator: Alireza Banaye Yazdipour, Seyed Mohammad Ayyoubzadeh, Salman Nazary‐Moghadam, Goli Arji, Fatemeh Sadat Mirmohammad Meigooni, Khalil Kimiafar, Leila Shahmoradi
pmc-11403353.description: IntroductionNowadays, the demand for physical therapy services has grown significantly over the last few decades due to an aging population, a rise in chronic conditions, and increased awareness of the benefits of physical therapy for injury recovery and managing various health issues. Collecting and managing data from physical therapy services is highly significant and beneficial.

pmc-11511227.title: Super Learner Algorithm for Carotid Artery Disease Diagnosis: A Machine Learning Approach Leveraging Craniocervical CT Angiography
pmc-11511227.creator: Halil İbrahim Özdemir, Kazım Gökhan Atman, Hüseyin Şirin, Abdullah Engin Çalık, Ibrahim Senturk, Metin Bilge, İsmail Oran, Duygu Bilge, Celal Çınar
pmc-11511227.description: This study introduces a machine learning (ML) approach to diagnosing carotid artery diseases, including stenosis, aneurysm, and dissection, by leveraging craniocervical computed tomography angiography (CTA) data. A meticulously curated, balanced dataset of 122 patient cases was used, ensuring reproducibility and data quality, and this is publicly accessible at (insert dataset location).

pmc-11643579.title: Preparation and Evaluation of a Novel Branched Polymer as Thickener for Calcium Chloride-Based Drilling and Completion Fluids
pmc-11643579.creator: Xianbin Zhang, Zhongfeng Yang, Qian Wang, Weijie Chen, Tengjiao Liu, Tao Zhou, Shulin Li, Tongle Xin, Jie Cao, Xia Xin, Sergey A Khrapak
pmc-11643579.description: Calcium halide-based fluids are often used in drilling and completion operations due to their high density, clay inhibition and low solid content. However, there is a lack of thickeners to promote gel strength, which improves the fluid’s capacity to carry and suspend cuttings.

pmc-11670784.title: Understanding early maladaptive schemas in autistic and ADHD individuals: exploring the impact, changing the narrative, and schema therapy considerations
pmc-11670784.creator: Liam Spicer, Emma DeCicco, Anna Clarke, Rikki Ambrosius, Ozgur Yalcin
pmc-11670784.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Autistic/ADHD individuals are increasingly recognised as a valid minority group, with consistent research demonstrating a higher prevalence of co-occurring mental health conditions such as PTSD, anxiety, depression, substance use, and eating disorders among other mental health challenges. Due to this, there is increasing focus on the adaptations required for Autistic and ADHD individuals of current therapeutic approaches such as Schema Therapy.

pmc-11673077.title: Automated Assessment of the Pulmonary Artery-to-Ascending Aorta Ratio in Fetal Cardiac Ultrasound Screening Using Artificial Intelligence
pmc-11673077.creator: Rina Aoyama, Masaaki Komatsu, Naoaki Harada, Reina Komatsu, Akira Sakai, Katsuji Takeda, Naoki Teraya, Ken Asada, Syuzo Kaneko, Kazuki Iwamoto, Ryu Matsuoka, Akihiko Sekizawa, Ryuji Hamamoto, Paolo Zaffino, Maria Francesca Spadea
pmc-11673077.description: The three-vessel view (3VV) is a standardized transverse scanning plane used in fetal cardiac ultrasound screening to measure the absolute and relative diameters of the pulmonary artery (PA), ascending aorta (Ao), and superior vena cava, as required. The PA/Ao ratio is used to support the diagnosis of congenital heart disease (CHD).

pmc-12588932.title: Latent profile analysis of perceived vulnerability among parents of children with febrile seizures
pmc-12588932.creator: Yaxiu Cai, Haihong Zhu, Yanping Du, Xiaohong Wang, Cuie Chen, Yanping Jiang, Yuxiang Lan
pmc-12588932.description: BackgroundCertain parents of children with febrile seizures have a high sense of perceived vulnerability, which may lead to overprotective behaviors. This study aimed to measure the latent profile types of perceived vulnerability in parents of children with febrile seizures and investigate the factors affecting these different profiles.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted from October 2023 to December 2024.

pmc-12654666.title: Prevalence, Clinical, and Immunological Features of Familial Type 1 Diabetes Among Children and Adolescents: A Retrospective Study from Saudi Arabia
pmc-12654666.creator: Raed Abutaleb, Saeed Yafei, Abdulrahman Hummadi, Yahia Solan, Abdullah Khawaji, Mohammed Hakami, Ali Jaber Alhagawy, Amer Al Ali, Morghema Adawi, Azizah Makrami, Fatima Bahsan, Molouk Mashhour, Lina Khardaly, Dalia Zahrani, Raga Johar, Nouf Algohani
pmc-12654666.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and Objectives: Familial type 1 diabetes (FT1D) represents a distinct subgroup of T1D potentially influenced by shared genetic and environmental factors. Data from Middle Eastern populations—where both T1D incidence and consanguinity are high—remain limited. This study aimed to determine the prevalence of FT1D and to compare the clinical, metabolic, and immunological features of FT1D with non-familial T1D (NFT1D) among children and adolescents in Saudi Arabia.

pmc-12666847.title: Analyzing qPCR data: Better practices to facilitate rigor and reproducibility
pmc-12666847.creator: Thomas H Hampton, Lily Taub, Kiyoshi Ferreria-Fukutani, Bruce A Stanton, Todd A MacKenzie
pmc-12666847.description: Graphical abstractQuantitative PCR (qPCR) remains a widely used, cost-effective method for RNA quantitation, yet many published studies inadequately comply with MIQE (Minimum Information for Publication of Quantitative Real-Time PCR Experiments) and FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reproducible) data principles. Widespread reliance on the 2−ΔΔCT method often overlooks critical factors such as amplification efficiency variability and reference gene stability.

pmc-12749241.title: Synergistic structural performance of green self-compacting concrete enhanced by nano-clay and waste glass powder
pmc-12749241.creator: Sheelan Mahmoud Hama, Ibrahim A. AL-Jumaily, Elaf Khalid Dahamm, Mohamed Ghalla, Md. Habibur Rahman Sobuz, Sani Aliyu Abubakar, George Wardeh, M. Z. A. M. Zahid, Taher A. Tawfik, W. Zaki
pmc-12749241.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study presents a novel investigation into the performance of structural for reinforced self-compacting concrete (SCC) beams including waste glass powder (WGP) and nano-clay (NC) as sustainable partial replacements for cement. Unlike prior studies that focus on individual effects, this research evaluates the combined influence of NC plus WGP blends on full-scale beam behavior using advanced Digital Image Correlation (DIC) techniques. Ten SCC mixtures were designed across three series: NC-only, WGP-only, and hybrid NC–WGP mixes (constant 15% total binder replacement).

pmc-12767591.title: Nerve Grafts in Breast Reconstruction: A Narrative Review
pmc-12767591.creator: Yan Shen, Juan Zhang, Yihua Liu, Haifeng Cai, Karuna Sharma
pmc-12767591.description: Breast reconstruction post‐mastectomy restores breast aesthetics and significantly enhances patients’ self‐confidence and psychological well‐being. However, despite the effectiveness of current breast reconstruction techniques in restoring the aesthetic appearance of the breast, many patients continue to experience the loss of breast sensation following surgery, particularly the loss of nipple sensitivity, which significantly impacts postoperative quality of life.

pmc-12975701.title: Bayesian Sensitivity Analysis for Causal Estimation With Time‐Varying Unmeasured Confounding
pmc-12975701.creator: Yushu Zou, Liangyuan Hu, Amanda Ricciuto, Mark Deneau, Kuan Liu
pmc-12975701.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Causal inference relies on the untestable assumption of no unmeasured confounding to ensure the causal parameter of interest is identifiable. Sensitivity analysis quantifies the unmeasured confounding's impact on causal estimates. pmc-13175560.title: Long-term outcomes of endoscopic pilonidal sinus treatment: A single tertiary centre experience
pmc-13175560.creator: Lakshay Singla, Ramya Kalaiselvan, Ajai Samad, Michael Chadwick, Rajaganeshan Rajasundram
pmc-13175560.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Introduction:Pilonidal sinus disease commonly affects young adults and presents a clinical challenge due to high recurrence rates. This study aims to evaluate long-term outcomes following Endoscopic Pilonidal Sinus Treatment (EPSIT) performed at a UK district general hospital.Patients and Methods:We conducted a retrospective observational study of all adult patients who underwent EPSIT by a single colorectal surgeon between January 2015 and May 2022. Patients with acute abscesses or previous extensive surgery were excluded.

pmc-13399753.title: Ulnar Collateral Ligament Reconstruction Through a Mini‐Invasive Approach and Suture Anchor Fixation
pmc-13399753.creator: Valeria Vismara, Carlos Murillo Nieto, Alfonso Gonzalez‐Delgado C, Gregoire Ciais, Pierre Laumonerie
pmc-13399753.description: Valgus stability of the elbow joint is mostly provided by the ulnar collateral ligament (UCL), which is composed of 3 bundles: anterior, posterior, and transverse. Many surgical techniques for UCL reconstruction have been described since Dr. Jobe's first introduced a technique using a free tendon graft and bone tunnel fixation on both the ulnar and humeral side.

pmc-13481252.title: A VIM2/4 deletion, and premature truncations of CMT2 and FBX5, drive DNA methylation changes after colonization of a novel habitat
pmc-13481252.creator: Johan Zicola, Emmanuel Tergemina, Ahmed F. Elfarargi, Mehmet Göktay, Célia Neto, Robert J. Schmitz, Angela M. Hancock
pmc-13481252.description: DNA methylation is important to maintain genome stability, but alterations in genome-wide methylation patterns can produce widespread genomic effects, with the potential to facilitate rapid adaptation. Here we investigate DNA methylation evolution in Arabidopsis thaliana during its colonization of the drought-prone Cape Verde Islands (CVI).
